question_text: Compare a single central controller with a distributed set of room controllers managing a building.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Both process sensor inputs to control room conditions. A central controller simplifies coordinated changes but its failure may affect all rooms. Distributed controllers can continue local operation after another controller fails but require coordination/configuration across several nodes.

marking_points.criterion: Distributed coordination complexity or another paired contrast.
